prompt:
Desktop web UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of Marketo's portfolio page (the book). Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names (like Big Shoulders Display), Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks are a red #e42c22 square with letters BTC; ETH silks a blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, rules, silks squares, masthead chrome, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference content: do not put a selected horse name as the giant call. The giant call is the BOOK TOTALS, not a horse.

STRUCTURE: (1) Thin masthead ~8% height: MARKETO left; weekday date; line "heroes fight dreamDEX BTC / ETH event markets"; EN/ID locale invert chips; THE PROGRAM and ENTER A HORSE marks at right. (2) Below a 3px ink rule, the FOLD is the landing three-region grid. LEFT/CENTER CALL (~55%): huge extra-condensed title YOUR BOOK, then call-scale PnL +1,240.00 in purse green, caption CAPITAL AT RISK 4,500.00 in carbon ink, tiny inverted SYNTHETIC tags on both figures. No horse name at this scale. RIGHT FACTS (~35%): a 55% Hot Sheet washed slip titled SETTLE THIS HORSE. Picked line: red BTC silks square, "1 WARDEN", agate "BACKED · 15m vs BTC". Amount underline field 250.00, chip row +10 +50 +100 +250, EST SHARES 5.26% with SYNTHETIC tag, green rubber-stamp DEPOSIT (multiply, like the reference stamp), and beside it a scratched-style outlined WITHDRAW (transparent, 1px ink stroke, not a filled button, not green). BOTTOM PROGRAM STRIP (~18%): two coasts divided by a 3px ink rule. Left coast BACKED: 1 WARDEN BTC, 2 KITE ETH, 3 ASH ETH as program-entry buttons (number, silks, name, your PnL). Right coast MINE: 4 REDLINE BTC with a MINE tag, watch-only, no withdraw. WARDEN row has the 8% ink wash as selected. Selecting updates the slip only; the call stays YOUR BOOK.

Visitor job (see book PnL, then deposit more or withdraw from the selected backed horse) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no fake press, no testimonials, no rounded corners, no dashboard cards.
